result:
No risk at Likelihood 3 or higher is unsettled. `bun tools/check-register.ts` exited 0 and printed `Likelihood 3 or higher and not closed, accepted, mitigated, transferred or Moved Out: 0`. It also reported 436 items, 0 settled with no Verified line, 0 Moved Out for a reason other than a part `plugins/` doesn't ship, and 0 with two Likelihood values.

I also read the register files directly, because the checker may look at only one Status line per entry. I took the last Status line in each entry as its current one. Of the 26 entries with more than one Status line, 20 are at Likelihood 3 or higher. Each of them ends on `mitigated` or `closed`, and all but RISK-186 and RISK-410 carry an earlier Status line that was `open` or `partial`.

| Entry | L | Current status | Reason the entry records |
|---|---|---|---|
| RISK-374 | 5 | mitigated 2026-11-18 | Earlier status was `partial`. The spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused. |
| RISK-393 | 3 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | The fill no longer writes a `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the old one, so a paid run asks first. An earlier acceptance of the risk was the user's to give and was withdrawn. |
| RISK-166 | 4 | closed 2026-11-19 | Not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327. The earlier BUILD line is superseded. |
| RISK-170 | 4 | mitigated 2026-11-18 | The shipped agent files cover it. |
| RISK-171 | 4 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | The consent paragraph in the output style and the three agent files beats vanilla on r171b and r171d and holds level on both controls. Before that it was `open`, because no shipped part stopped a subagent answering a nested prompt. |
| RISK-186 | 5 | mitigated 2026-11-19 (bb4fdbf4, RISK-499, issue #45) | The rebuild's own Bash wrapper made git commands in isolated worktrees non-simple, so they were refused. A command naming git is now left unwrapped. An intermediate `accepted` status (the worktree guard is the engine's) was superseded. |
| RISK-053 | 4 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | The wall guard failed open on `~/./`, `~//`, `~/x/..` and an unclosed `[` (#42). It now folds those paths and escapes `[`, and `wall.test.ts` covers all four. |
| RISK-103 | 4 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | The gap was the prefix form of the deny rules, not the subagent. `rules.ts` adds middle-wildcard forms, and a fake-API probe denied all of the cases. |
| RISK-226, RISK-352, RISK-353 | 4, 5, 5 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | The earlier `closed` status was reversed to `open` when the fault reproduced on vanilla. The defect paragraph in the output style now beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls. |
| RISK-227 | 3 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | Same closed-then-open history. The output style plus the redact guard beat vanilla on env1 (5/6 vs 1/6) and env2 (6/6 vs 0/6) and hold level on both controls (6/6 each). |
| RISK-262, RISK-264 | 5, 5 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | Earlier status was `open`. The same defect paragraph beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls. |
| RISK-410 | 4 | closed | The cause is outside setup or outside claudetto (OUT-866, ADR-0190). |
| RISK-424 | 3 | mitigated 2026-11-18 | Earlier status was `open (rebuild)`. The threshold test pins the literal 70000. |
| RISK-451 | 4 | mitigated 2026-11-19 | An agent session had recorded an acceptance, which was reverted to `open` (issue #57) because accepting a risk is the user's call. The output-style paragraph on background exit status beats vanilla on r451a and r451d and holds level on the r451c control. |

Four of these, RISK-226, RISK-227, RISK-352 and RISK-353, went closed, then open, then mitigated on 2026-11-19. RISK-262 and RISK-264 went open, then mitigated.

Several mitigated statuses rest on comparison runs against vanilla, not on a cause removed. I did not re-run those runs, so I'm reporting the entries as recorded.
